name: CMMC Implementation
status: Phases 2–4 suspended (13 Jul 2026) pending a 60-day review; DFARS 252.204-7012/7021, SPRS scores, and annual affirmations remain in force.
importance: High — governs DIB compliance spend and contract-award eligibility.
assessment: Policy pause, not repeal; a reformed program and reset timeline are the leading outcome.
lastChange: 2026-09-06 — reaffirmed pause; DFARS clauses still active.
orgRelevance: Maintain 800-171 controls, SPRS currency, and C3PAO readiness; re-plan assessment timing only.
nextIndicator: Federal Register notice or DoD determination concluding the review.

history.note: DoD suspends CMMC Phases 2–4 pending 60-day review.
Pause continues; safeguarding + SPRS obligations unchanged.

name: Critical Minerals / Rare-Earth Magnets
status: China's magnet-license denial to military-affiliated firms (since 1 Dec 2025) continues to pressure U.S. production; DoD funding domestic mine-to-magnet.
importance: Critical — binding constraint on munitions/platform output.
assessment: Durable, weaponizable chokepoint; structural risk HIGH, near-term program impact MODERATE.
orgRelevance: Map magnet exposure in hardware BOMs; pursue second sources.
nextIndicator: DoD mine-to-magnet award cadence; any PRC licensing change.

history.note: China imposes rare-earth export controls on 7 of 17 elements.
License denial extended to military-affiliated foreign firms.
Continued strain; DoD invests in domestic capacity.

importance: High — trust-boundary components common in DIB networks.

lastChange: 2026-09-06 — new KEV adds with reported in-the-wild exploitation.
orgRelevance: Patch and threat-hunt now; verify DFARS 7012 safeguarding evidence.
nextIndicator: Vendor patches; further KEV adds; defense-sector intrusion reporting.

orgRelevance: Assess positioning on SDA/MDA vehicles; heavy integration/MBSE content.
nextIndicator: MDA SHIELD task orders; SDA launches; interceptor prototype milestones.
